title: Psalm 130
opening_line: LORD, from the depths to thee I cried.

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: LORD, from the depths to thee I cried.
text.normalized: LORD, from the depths to thee I cried.
text.reading: LORD, from the depths to thee I cried.

text.diplomatic: My voice, Lord, do thou hear:
text.normalized: My voice, Lord, do thou hear:
text.reading: My voice, Lord, do thou hear:

text.diplomatic: Unto my supplications’ voice
text.normalized: Unto my supplications’ voice
text.reading: Unto my supplications’ voice

text.diplomatic: give an attentive ear.
text.normalized: Give an attentive ear.
text.reading: give an attentive ear.

text.diplomatic: Lord, who shall stand, if thou, O LORD,
text.normalized: Lord, who shall stand, if thou, O LORD,
text.reading: Lord, who shall stand, if thou, O LORD,

text.diplomatic: should’st mark iniquity?
text.normalized: Should’st mark iniquity?
text.reading: should’st mark iniquity?

text.diplomatic: But yet with thee forgiveness is,
text.normalized: But yet with thee forgiveness is,
text.reading: But yet with thee forgiveness is,

text.diplomatic: that fear’d thou mayest be.
text.normalized: That fear’d thou mayest be.
text.reading: that fear’d thou mayest be.

text.diplomatic: I wait for GOD, my soul doth wait,
text.normalized: I wait for GOD, my soul doth wait,
text.reading: I wait for GOD, my soul doth wait,

text.diplomatic: my hope is in his word.
text.normalized: My hope is in his word.
text.reading: my hope is in his word.

text.diplomatic: More than they that for morning watch,
text.normalized: More than they that for morning watch,
text.reading: More than they that for morning watch,

text.diplomatic: my soul waits for the Lord;
text.normalized: My soul waits for the Lord;
text.reading: my soul waits for the Lord;

text.diplomatic: I say, more than they that do watch
text.normalized: I say, more than they that do watch
text.reading: I say, more than they that do watch

text.diplomatic: the morning light to see.
text.normalized: The morning light to see.
text.reading: the morning light to see.

text.diplomatic: Let Israèl hope in the LORD,
text.normalized: Let Israèl hope in the LORD,
text.reading: Let Israèl hope in the LORD,

text.diplomatic: for with him mercies be;
text.normalized: For with him mercies be;
text.reading: for with him mercies be;

text.diplomatic: And plenteous redëmption
text.normalized: And plenteous redëmption
text.reading: And plenteous redëmption

text.diplomatic: is ever found with him.
text.normalized: Is ever found with him.
text.reading: is ever found with him.

text.diplomatic: And from all his iniquities
text.normalized: And from all his iniquities
text.reading: And from all his iniquities

text.diplomatic: he Isr’el shall redeem.
text.normalized: He Isr’el shall redeem.
text.reading: he Isr’el shall redeem.
